thread:
Lina M.: Quick planning thread for RustCon meetup next week. Need run-of-show, swag pickup plan, speaker slide deadline, and lead capture flow.

Omar R.: I can own run-of-show and AV. What time is our 30m talk?

Lina M.: Talk at 13:15. We have booth slot 10:00-17:00. 30m talk set for 13:15-13:45.

Ben K.: Swag inventory: 150 tees (S-XL mix), 100 stickers, 50 enamel pins, 30 hoodies. Thinking split into giveaway vs staff boxes.

Priya S.: Recommend gating the pins for demo signups to drive booth visits. QR -> Airtable form -> Zap to HubSpot. Who builds the form?

Lina M.: Priya can build form. Include field: interest (demo/enterprise/partnership). Also add UTM param capture.

Omar R.: AV notes: need 2 power outlets, HDMI cable, AV table. Bringing 2 laptops + mini-router. Will test slide deck with local video clip.

Ben K.: Placing swag order today. Order ref RDW-CLR-442. ETA Thu morning. Ops pickup window Fri 08:00 or Sat 07:30. Which do we want?

Priya S.: Prefer Fri pickup so we can QA items on site. Ops?

ops-bot: Shipping label created RDW-CLR-442. Carrier: ShipQuick. Tracking: https://shipquick.example/track/RDW-CLR-442

Lina M.: Run-of-show draft:
- 09:00 booth arrive, unload
- 09:30 table build + AV check
- 10:00 doors open, social posts go live
- 11:30 lightning demos start (2x 10m)
- 13:15 main talk (Redwood: low-latency benchmarks)
- 14:00 office hours + demos at booth
- 16:30 teardown begins

Omar R.: Can we add a 5-min micro-demo during the 11:30 lightning set? I can do it.

Priya S.: Speaker slides due 24h prior (by 1839900000). I'll upload to shared drive and ping speakers.

Ben K.: Swag packing: 6 boxes labeled A-F. Boxes A-C = giveaway, D-F = staff/backups. I'll drop at storage by Thu 17:00 for Fri pickup.

Lina M.: Lead routing mapping:
- demo -> demos@redwood.com
- enterprise -> sales@redwood.com
- partnerships -> partnerships@redwood.com
Ensure Zap sends source=rustcon for attribution.

Priya S.: Form built and test zap sent. Received in demos queue, HubSpot contact created with source=rustcon.

Omar R.: Smoke test pass on AV and slides, video plays locally. Bringing Ethernet cable as backup.

Ben K.: Packing note: reduce hoodies to 20, tees 140, stickers 110, pins 50. Updating order now.

Lina M.: Final: I'll post event thread to social at 09:45 day-of with QR link. Everyone confirm ownership: Omar (AV/run-of-show), Ben (swag/order + packing), Priya (form + slides), Lina (social + overall).

Omar R.: Confirmed.

Ben K.: Confirmed.

Priya S.: Confirmed, slides will be uploaded by EOD tomorrow.
